title: Smoked mackerel toast with apricots and chives

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is real food. Horseradish sauce is a traditional condiment on the store cupboard list, just like mustard.

supermarket.reason: Smoked mackerel, apricots, watercress, Greek yoghurt and wholemeal bread are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a fork and the grill, and the technique is mashing and toasting.

works.reason: 200g mackerel mashed with 150g yoghurt spreads well across 8 slices for four, the seasoning is balanced by the lemon and horseradish, and grilled toast needs no guesswork.

honest_times.reason: Skinning and flaking the fish, zesting the lemon, stoning six apricots and snipping chives fits in 15 minutes, and 4 minutes is right for grilling toast on both sides.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, nothing unlisted appears, and 'wholemeal bread' matches the bread id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Six fresh apricots dressed with chives and lemon make a substantial topping on a light, no-cook summer breakfast suited to late July, though the title leads with the mackerel.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish, yoghurt, wholemeal toast, fruit and greens make a filling, balanced breakfast.
